natural.source: Uniform natural-background scenario; not measured separately.

artificial.source: Fixed source coefficient of the reference scene; no independent absolute inversion.

method.phase_reference: geocentric; illuminated fraction is not lunar flux
method.eclipse_screen: Conservative spherical penumbra geometry; no eclipse photometry.
method.limitations: Geometry only; no scattered moonlight, horizon glow or optics glare.

band.name: V
band.response_reference: doi:10.1086/132921; no numerical spectral response imported

photometry.band_bridge: City: explicit Generic/Johnson.V integration; Moon: empirical KS V; natural: V-only scenario.

provenance.normalisation: Fixed regional radiance-area reference before observer exclusions; removed power is not restored.

scope.height_datum: Input height is AGL above DSM; transfer radial height approximates EGM2008 orthometric MSL on a sphere.

artificial_provenance.source: Fixed source coefficient of the reference scene; no independent absolute inversion.

catalogue.catalogue: Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Edition (preliminary), Hoffleit & Warren (1991)
catalogue.selection: Require Vmag, spectral type and coordinates; excludes non-stellar/empty records.
catalogue.frame: FK5 J2000; proper motions in arcsec/year, RA tangent component includes cos(dec)
catalogue.precision: HEASARC coordinates as supplied; not a catalogue complete to arbitrary faint magnitudes.
catalogue.reuse: Astronomical catalogue data from NASA HEASARC. Cite original authors and provider; no external software source copied.

astrometry.proper_motion: J2000 tangent-vector propagation; no perspective acceleration or stellar parallax
astrometry.iers: Offline bundled tables from lock-pinned astropy-iers-data
astrometry.earth_geometry: WGS84 astrometry; spherical Earth in transfer solver

stars_metadata.flux_reference: V magnitude 0 point-source flux; NOT the diffuse Bref

spectral.flux_unit: W/(m2 nm) point-source irradiance; not per sr
spectral.model: Measured SED shapes where available; otherwise B-V Planck continuum scenario.
spectral.scope: exported stars after DSM visibility mask

spectral_counts_before_terrain_mask.flux_unit: W/(m2 nm) point-source irradiance; not per sr
spectral_counts_before_terrain_mask.model: Measured SED shapes where available; otherwise B-V Planck continuum scenario.

background_model.zenith_normalisation: observed diffuse night zenith scenario in CURRENT atmosphere
background_model.airglow: van Rhijn thin spherical shell + direct Beer attenuation; scattering into ray omitted

surface_model.fraction_domain: illumination-weighted fraction of source ground under lamps; uniform regional scenario
surface_model.spectral_albedo: grey constant over model band; no snow colour predicted
